recommendations.regimenLabel: Early DMARD (methotrexate) + steroid bridge + symptom relief
steps: Early referral to rheumatology — 'treat to target' (remission/low disease activity).
Start a DMARD early (methotrexate first-line) ± short-term steroid bridge.
Escalate to combination DMARDs or a biologic/targeted synthetic DMARD if inadequate response.
NSAID for symptom relief; monitor DMARD toxicity (FBC, LFTs).
Manage cardiovascular risk, bone health and vaccination.

drugRefs.dose: 10–15 mg once weekly, titrate to 20–25 mg weekly
drugRefs.why: Anchor DMARD for RA; started early to control disease and prevent erosions. Monitor FBC/LFTs.

drugRefs.dose: 5 mg once weekly (on a different day to methotrexate)

drugRefs.why: Rapid symptom control while the DMARD takes effect; kept short-term to avoid steroid toxicity.
Analgesia/anti-inflammatory for symptom relief; add gastroprotection and use lowest effective dose.

drugRefs.dose: 500 mg daily, titrated to 1 g twice daily
drugRefs.why: Used in combination DMARD therapy when methotrexate alone is inadequate.
Component of triple therapy; requires baseline/annual retinal monitoring.
Biologic DMARD for inadequate response to conventional DMARDs; screen for latent TB/hepatitis first.
